title: THREE WAYS IN, THREE TAKEAWAYS

items.title: Cloud agent + generated cutouts
items.text: authors the recipe and the DESIGN.md contract, generates true-alpha PNGs (SOP.md) and pins them in the example bundle

items.title: 100% local LLM, offline
items.text: reads SYSTEM-INSTRUCTIONS.md and DESIGN.md, edits fixture.json, self-corrects from the renderer's overflow and overlap findings, draws inline SVG

items.title: CI job or backend, no AI at runtime
items.text: renders, validates and edits with --set / --save: no network, no paid calls, the same bytes every time

takeaways.label: TAKEAWAYS
items: Every later edit touches one element.
Recipes and DESIGN.md make the design durable input, not a one-shot prompt.

closing: Deck source: examples/2026-10-29-talk-deck/ · every slide here is a fixture rendered by the engine
